Description: A body within the cell, surrounded by a membrane, within which lie the chromosomes, one or more nucleoli, combined with proteins, and exhibits mitosis.
The protoplasm of a cell outside the nucleus, bounded by the plasma membrane and containing all of the cell's organelles except the nucleus.
The semipermeable membrane that encloses the cytoplasm of a cell.
The smallest units of living structure capable of independent existence, composed of a membrane-enclosed mass of protoplasm and containing a nucleus or nucleoid.
A discrete, localized region of signal (e.g. a fluorescent punctum) identified within an image, distinct from whole-cell or subcellular compartment segmentation.
Different than the one(s) previously specified or mentioned.
